name: xbind-shell
about: the tool calls of xbind-shell.json after its last event, as ToolRecords (/vendor/chat/blocks.js), in the order they began — seq: the event that began the call; turn: the turn it was made in. A field at its zero value is left out.

rec.title: echo hi > made.txt && sed -i 's/main() {}/main() { println(1) }/' main.go

rawInput.command: echo hi > made.txt && sed -i 's/main() {}/main() { println(1) }/' main.go

patch.text:
diff --git a/made.txt b/made.txt
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..45b983b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/made.txt
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+hi
diff --git a/main.go b/main.go
index 38dd16d..508ac32 100644
--- a/main.go
+++ b/main.go
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 package main
 
-func main() {}
+func main() { println(1) }
